tech.art_style: 3D 写实体育，NCAA 球队/球员

dim_notes.engine: Frostbite 为 EA 专有引擎，外界不可得，复刻需自研等价物
dim_notes.art: 包体约 1.17GB（很重），写实球员模型/球场/球衣资产海量
dim_notes.anim: 动作捕捉球员动画 + 比赛特写，动画量级极高
dim_notes.physics: 球员碰撞/擒抱/传球轨迹需物理与手感精调
dim_notes.logic: Ultimate Team 抽卡经济 + Dynasty 多赛季养成 + 实时比赛模拟，系统极复杂
dim_notes.data: 真实球员数据库 + 养成 + 赛季进程，数值与经济循环重
dim_notes.server: 实时联机对战 + 全球赛季同步，强联网

tech.asset_notes: 写实 3D 体育资产 + Frostbite 引擎，包体 1.17GB，复刻所需资源与引擎均不可得。
tech.notes: EA 首款上 Frostbite 的手游，引擎与 IP 双重壁垒，技术上不可复刻。

play.core_loop: 组建大学橄榄球 Ultimate Team→招募新秀/养成阵容→打赛季与实时比赛→赢取奖励强化阵容，单局比赛数分钟。
highlights: 真实 NCAA 球队/德比氛围的代入感
Ultimate Team 抽卡养成的收集驱动
实时比赛操作 + 战术布置的双重参与
innovations: 无实质创新，属于成熟品类的执行优化（Madden/UT 体系移植到大学橄榄球）
play.target_user: 北美男性体育手游用户
play.monetization: IAP 内购（虚拟货币抽卡/物品）为主
play.lifecycle: 长线运营，跟 NCAA 赛季更新

clone.rationale: NCAA 体育 IP 独占 + EA Frostbite 引擎不可得 + 1.17GB 重包体，技术与版权双重不可行。
suggestions: 仅作技术参考，勿尝试复刻

evidence.claim: 引擎为 Frostbite（EA 首款上 Frostbite 的手游，公开资料确认）

media.description:
This game includes optional in-game purchases of virtual currency that can be used to acquire virtual in-game items, including a random selection of virtual in-game items. .

Create and play your college football Ultimate Team™ in EA SPORTS™ College Football Mobile 27.

Build your dream program as you recruit future stars, develop your roster, and lead your school through unforgettable college football seasons. Experience authentic college football traditions, fierce rivalries, real-world gameplay moments, and strategic team-building designed specifically for mobile.

Whether you're building a National Championship contender, managing your recruiting class, or taking on your fiercest rival, every decision shapes the future of your program.

Download EA SPORTS™ College Football Mobile 27 and start building your team today.

NOTICE: College Football 27 Mobile is best enjoyed on iPhone 13 Pro, iPhone 13 Pro Max, and all iPhone 14, 15, 16, and 17 models, iPad Pro (M1 or newer), iPad Air (5th generation or newer), and iPad mini (A17 Pro)

EA SPORTS™ COLLEGE FOOTBALL MOBILE 27 FEATURES

AUTHENTIC COLLEGE FOOTBALL EXPERIENCE

* Experience the traditions, rivalries, and excitement of college football
* Compete in authentic gameplay inspired by real-world college football programs and teams
* Manage your favorite programs
* Play through seasonal events inspired by the biggest moments in college football
* Feel the passion of game day from your mobile device

REAL-WORLD GAMEPLAY

* Experience live events connected to the college football season
* Re-live major matchups and memorable moments
* Take on new challenges throughout the season
* Earn rewards and strengthen your program

BUILD YOUR PROGRAM with DYNASTY RUSH MODE (Coming Soon)

* Manage real-world college football programs over multiple seasons
* Recruit top prospects and build your program from the ground up
* Manage recruiting classes and navigate the transfer portal
* Build your team of college stars through long-term progression systems
* Experience dynamic storylines and season-defining decisions
* Create a legacy across multiple college football seasons

BUILD YOUR ULTIMATE TEAM™ 

* Collect and upgrade players
* Build a team tailored to your playstyle
* Improve team chemistry and performance
* Complete challenges and earn rewards throughout the season
* Create your dream college football lineup
* Use strategy throughout each season to build a team that’s leagues better than the rest
* Enjoy a fresh and fun twist on college football competition with your favorite mascots
* Celebrate school traditions in exciting new ways

FOOTBALL MANAGER GAMEPLAY

* Manage your roster and guide your team to victory
* Make strategic decisions on and off the field
* Develop players and strengthen your program
* Showcase your coaching skills and football knowledge 
* Manage a championship-winning culture with your team

NEXT-LEVEL COLLEGE FOOTBALL VISUALS

* Experience immersive stadium environments
* Enjoy enhanced graphics and authentic game-day presentation
* Feel the atmosphere of college football rivalries and traditions
* Watch your program come to life with dynamic visuals and gameplay

why.text: 用户被 NCAA 真实球队/球员肖像与 Ultimate Team 抽卡养成锁死，这套代入感离开 IP 与授权即不成立
我们的休闲产品用户要的是碎片时间解压，不缺体育模拟这类重操作、重授权的长线养成体验
NCAA 体育 IP 独占 + EA Frostbite 引擎不可得 + 1.17GB 重包体，技术版权双重壁垒，与常规休闲产品线冲突
不碰反而省掉重资本体育手游的授权与引擎投入，把资源留给可轻量复刻的休闲品类

how: 仅取可迁移的「球队养成 + 赛季目标」外壳，用无 IP 的虚拟校队题材做轻量收集活动，不碰真实球队授权
把 Ultimate Team 抽卡节奏抽成通用「阵容收集」组件，接进现有收集线验证 LTV 提升
gain: 规避 NCAA/球员肖像授权与 Frostbite 引擎的千万级投入
拿走「赛季目标 + 阵容养成」双循环设计作为可复用收集框架
省掉 1.17GB 重包体带来的下载转化与买量成本
明确不立项重资本体育手游，避免团队在不可行方向反复讨论

points: EA 自研自发且 IP 独占，NCAA 球队/球员肖像授权不放权，无代理或联运通道
体量远超常规休闲小游戏团队，无并购或合作可谈空间

scenes.how: 把「阵容收集 + 赛季目标」换成无 IP 的虚拟校队应援榜，做轻量赛事活动位

biz.summary: 体育 IP 与引擎不可搬；仅取养成框架做轻量活动
